title: Settings
subtitle: Account, API configuration, model selection

compute.account_lead: Signing in decides which compute tier you can use: phone registration includes a trial quota; third-party sign-in only requires your own API, local CLI or local endpoint.
compute.identity_desc: The session is kept by a JWT issued by the local service; signing out does not affect local data.
compute.session_note: No re-login within the session window
compute.quota_eligibility_desc: Shared channel is limited to users registered with a mainland China phone number
compute.login_hint: Sign in to enable the trial quota; own Key and local chains need no login.
compute.usage_desc: Transcription and summary share one quota pool, metered by processed audio minutes.
compute.sovereignty_desc: The main service runs on your machine; the cloud only computes and never stores business data.
compute.sov_out_val: Transcription & summary requests (depends on the source)
compute.ai_lead: This page governs every AI call except Agent chats: summary, chapter titles, action extraction, transcript optimization, the selection toolbar, the Insight Deck and Insight Board, plus the default compute for AI chats. Sources are peers — switch anytime. Agent chats run on your local CLI with its own credits, unaffected by this page.
compute.ai_trial_meta: Free trial quota · shares quota with transcription · data leaves local
compute.month_quota_desc: Metered by processed audio minutes; auto-available once quota recovers.
compute.model_trial_tip: Trial quota runs in the cloud; local model names do not apply here — this shows the cloud model actually used
compute.quota_to_provider: Not enough? Configure your own API
compute.ai_provider_meta: Self-paid · models selectable · data leaves local
compute.ai_provider_desc: All are OpenAI-compatible; the key is written only to local config, never uploaded.
compute.ai_cli_meta: Borrows local CLI subscription · via local process · consumes no app quota
compute.ai_cli_desc: Reuse the subscription already logged in on your terminal to drive agent chat; credentials stay local and it is orthogonal to the summary compute source.
compute.ai_endpoint_meta: Self-hosted model · requests stay local · data stays local
compute.ai_endpoint_desc: When pointing at localhost the key may stay empty; requests never leave this machine.
compute.local_no_key: No key needed for a localhost endpoint
compute.ai_endpoint_note: Small local models suit light tasks (chapter titles, action extraction); for long minutes prefer cloud or local CLI.
compute.trial_meta: Data leaves local · {n} min left this month
compute.need_provider_hint: API provider not configured: fill the key and click "Save & enable" for it to take effect.
compute.need_endpoint_hint: Local endpoint not configured: fill the address and click "Save & enable" for it to take effect.
compute.need_login_hint: Trial quota needs sign-in: please sign in before choosing this source.
compute.need_local_hint: Local engine not ready: download models and start the engine before selecting it here.
compute.switch_failed: Switch failed: not applied, kept the previous source.
compute.cli_orthogonal_hint: Local CLI only drives agent chat (orthogonal to summary compute): enabling and configuring here will not change the summary source.
compute.asr_lead: Compute source for speech transcription. All three tiers take effect the moment you pick them; when the current source is unavailable, the next tier in the 01 → 02 → 03 ladder is switched to automatically. Switching source does not affect existing hotwords or voiceprints.
compute.asr_trial_meta: Free trial quota · shares quota with summary · data leaves local
compute.asr_trial_shared: Shares one quota pool with summary
compute.asr_trial_shared_desc: Transcription is metered by audio duration, summary is counted separately; combined within the monthly quota.
compute.ladder_fb_trial: When unavailable → auto-switch to 02 API provider
compute.ladder_fb_provider: When unavailable → auto-switch to 03 local engine
compute.ladder_fb_local: Last tier · nothing to switch to · resumes after recovery
compute.activated_notready_login: Selected as source · takes effect after sign-in
compute.activated_notready_key: Selected as source · takes effect once the key is saved
compute.activated_notready_engine: Selected as source · takes effect once models are ready
compute.asr_local_risk_note: ⚠ Switching to local will interrupt in-progress transcription/sessions and stop the cloud link.
compute.asr_provider_meta: Batch & realtime stream · hotword support · data leaves local
compute.asr_provider_desc: Batch and realtime use different models; the key is written only to local config.
compute.asr_local_meta: SeACo-Paraformer local transcription · offline-ready · data stays local
compute.asr_local_desc: The FunASR resident subprocess runs locally; choosing it makes only transcription run locally, without affecting the summary AI source (per-capability independent).
compute.local_risk: ⚠ Switching to local will interrupt in-progress transcription/sessions and stop the cloud link. Continue?
compute.engine_coldstart_val: Resident subprocess · first cold start up to ~120s
compute.model_manifest_desc: Guided download, not bundled; licenses follow each ModelScope model page.
compute.engine_lead: Local transcription engine: weights download on demand, the resident subprocess is reused. Enable it by choosing 'Local engine' as the transcription source in ASR settings — it affects transcription only, not the summary AI source.
compute.engine_switch_desc: Enabling only idles the engine locally; to transcribe with it you still choose it as the source in "ASR".

api_key_placeholder: Leave empty to use environment variable Key
llm_api_key_placeholder: Leave empty to keep current key
llm_local_no_key: Local endpoint needs no real key
llm_probe_models_hint: Local models loaded — pick or type
asr_source_hint: The source is chosen per capability on the Access Mode page (single write entry); shown here read-only
asr_api_key_placeholder: Leave empty to keep current key
llm_model_scope_note: Selection toolbar & summary pipeline use this model; the Insight Board is co-created by human & AI via chat
features_desc: Control real-time AI features during recording, all enabled by default
realtime_chapters_desc: Automatically split chapters by topic during recording
realtime_summary_desc: Generate incremental summaries at set intervals during recording
update_check_desc: Check for new versions on startup and prompt upgrade
version_info_desc: View current version and check for updates
check_update_error: Check failed, please try again later
voiceprint_auto_match_desc: Automatically match person identity via voiceprint after transcription (experimental, accuracy needs improvement)
interval_hint: Changes take effect on next recording
usage_login_hint: Log in to view recognition quota and usage. In local mode, configure your own API Key.
cloud_mode_hint: Currently using developer shared proxy, free within trial quota.
subscription_preference_desc: When you have both trial quota and your own API Key, choose the default compute source for the detail layer
prefer_subscription_desc: When checked, LLM / ASR details default to the trial quota (explicitly badged as default). A per-capability override is persisted and never reverted by sign-in or this checkbox
voiceprint_note: Voiceprint runs on local CAM++ only (the cloud extraction path has been retired) — zero egress, no configuration
diarization_desc: Control speaker diarization strategy; cloud is more accurate but uses quota
diarization_local_toggle_desc: When off, cloud diarization will be used (requires self-hosted Key)
diarization_requires_subscription: Requires self-hosted API Key or trial quota
output_dir_desc: Storage path for transcription results and recordings
recording_device_desc: Select the audio input device for recording; leave empty for auto-detection
recording_device_ffmpeg_missing: ffmpeg not installed; some device detection features unavailable
system_prompts_desc: View system-level prompts used by AI in each scenario (read-only)
cli_reference_desc: Quick reference for command-line tool operations
keyboard_shortcuts_desc: Global shortcut reference for faster workflows
reload_page_desc: Try reloading the page when the interface displays abnormally or is out of sync
disabled_commands_desc: Disabled AI shortcuts will not appear in the interface
watermark_desc: Background glow decoration effect, follows theme color scheme

access.expert_toggle_desc: When on: cards, detail cards and the flow matrix also show engineering values (the same model with a detail layer, not a parallel UI)
access.guide_title: One more step: pick an access mode
access.guide_desc: Offline / Online decides who provides the compute; the billing source is chosen per capability in the details below. Switch anytime. {hint}
access.guide_hint_ready: (Online sign-in condition already met; Offline needs none)
access.local_tagline: All compute on this machine · free · data never leaves the device (voiceprint structurally zero-egress)
access.cloud_tagline: At least one capability uses cloud compute · billing source chosen per capability below
access.switch_failed: Switching → failed: not applied, kept the previous mode (all fields unwritten, full rollback)
access.switch_succeeded: Switched to “{mode}”. The detail layer has updated.
access.preview_proc_local: Process action: start the local engine subprocess (missing components show “not ready” + a direct link to the asset list; no silent half-started state).
access.preview_proc_cloud: Process action: if the local engine is running, stop the subprocess and end the local session.
access.preview_risk_to_local: ⚠ Risk confirmation (Online → Offline): in-progress transcription/sessions will be interrupted and cloud sessions stopped. Tick the acknowledgement below before confirming.
access.preview_ack_local: I understand: switching to Offline will interrupt in-progress transcription
access.preview_bill_local: Billing & egress: no egress, no billing (voiceprint structurally zero-egress).
access.preview_bill_cloud: Billing & egress: trial quota = platform-paid (consumes minutes); own Key = billed by your provider; local endpoint = zero egress. Stated per capability, no silent rewrite.
access.preview_default_note: Account “prefer trial quota” is currently {state} ⇒ detail default “{source}”{suffix}
access.preview_suffix_first: ; changing a selection overrides it persistently
access.detail_title: Dependent details (per-capability selectable in Online mode; taken over read-only by the local chain in Offline mode)
access.detail_local_note: Offline: LLM / ASR cards are taken over locally; source selection is read-only
access.acct_psub_idle: Prefer trial quota (inactive in Offline mode)
access.acct_psub_note_on: When checked: LLM / ASR details default to the trial quota, badged “default”. Changing a selection per capability overrides the default, and the override persists across sign-ins and checkbox changes.
access.acct_psub_note_off: When unchecked: details default to “own Key”; capabilities without a Key show a not-ready warning. Quota is consumed only when explicitly selected in the details.
access.acct_psub_idle_toast: Inactive in Offline mode: compute sources are taken over by the local chain; this checkbox only sets the Online detail defaults.
access.acct_session_note: Sign in to enable the trial quota; own Key and local chains need no sign-in.
access.badge_default_tip: Click to jump to the account checkbox
access.badge_override_tip: You explicitly chose this; the override persists and is not reverted by sign-in or the checkbox
access.ready_trial_exhausted: Trial quota exhausted → automatically switching to your configured source; see billing below
access.ready_trial_no_fallback: Trial quota exhausted and no ready fallback source · capability temporarily unavailable
access.ready_need_login: ✗ Not signed in: trial quota unavailable (sign-in gate)
access.ready_byok_ok: ✓ Key ready · edited only on the Services page (explicit save)
access.ready_unset: Not set: choose a compute source for this capability
access.ready_local_engine_missing: ✗ Local engine not ready: models missing
access.ready_takeover: Local chain takeover (read-only) · see engine page for local model availability
access.bill_byok: Billing: own Key · billed by your provider
access.bill_shared_pool: · ASR/LLM share one quota pool (metering split pending ruling Q4)
access.edit_goto_services_toast: Jumping to the Services page — the single Key / Base URL / model editing surface (explicit save).
access.cta_back_trial: Switch back to trial (when quota recovers)
access.engine_note: When not ready the Offline card shows a yellow “not ready” badge with a direct link to the asset list.
access.vp_note: Voiceprint: local CAM++ only · zero egress (no cloud diarization path)
access.cli_note: Probe status is always visible here — see it before choosing “Agent” in the chat panel, no more failure-first discovery.
access.usage_note: Echoes here after switching the chat panel model picker; each reply footer shows the actual consumer and billing basis.
access.quota_banner: {n} capabilities switched to another compute source (explicit switch when the trial quota is unavailable — no silent rewrite)
access.quota_low_banner: Trial quota nearly exhausted ({n} left): consider pre-selecting Own Key or Local endpoint; when exhausted it auto-switches to a ready source
access.quota_banner_history: Recent auto-switch records: {n} (stored locally for billing disputes)
access.matrix_title: Data flow matrix (highlighted per current capability sources)
access.matrix_desc: Column headers use user vocabulary only (Offline / Trial quota / Own Key / Local endpoint); cells mark egress status; engineering values appear only in expert detail lines.
access.matrix_cell_audio_byok: Direct to your configured cloud ASR
access.matrix_cell_transcript_trial: Ephemeral cloud compute, stored on this machine only
access.matrix_cell_transcript_byok: Ephemeral cloud compute, stored on this machine only
access.matrix_note: Whatever the source, business data files (audio, transcripts, minutes, voiceprint registry) live only on your machine; cloud services do ephemeral compute and never retain business data.

prompts_desc: View built-in roles, or create custom roles from built-in ones and edit their behavior definitions
role_delete_confirm: Delete custom role '{name}'? This cannot be undone.
role_no_custom: No custom roles yet. Create one from a built-in role.

privacy_notice.text: Privacy notice: AI features such as speech recognition and summary generation rely on cloud APIs. Meeting audio and text will be transmitted to third-party services. Do not process sensitive content.

storage_desc: View disk usage and clean up intermediate files to free space
storage_auto_archive_desc: Automatically delete audio files of completed meetings after specified days (transcripts preserved)
cliengine_desc: The agent mode runs on a local CLI engine, orthogonal to the access mode — the only config-stack layer where 'installed by the user' is what counts.
cliengine_tier_readonly: Read-only (explicit downgrade: agent turns won't persist)
cliengine_cli_path: CLI path override (fill manually when probing fails)
cliengine_orthogonal_note: Orthogonal combination example: transcription set to Local engine + chat set to CLI agent = transcription runs locally while chat bills to the CLI sign-in account. ASR and LLM are configured independently — no implicit whole-machine switching.
cliengine_login_unchecked: Login status not checked (interactive login only)
engine_status_desc: Local engine run status and component readiness. This page is a read-only echo: whether transcription runs locally is chosen per-capability in ASR settings, without affecting the summary AI source.
engine_admin_only: Engine configuration is admin-level; your account has read-only access.
engine_start_failed: Failed to start engine, please retry
engine_stop_failed: Failed to stop engine, please retry
engine_ready_not_running: Models are ready but the engine process is not running; you can start it manually.
engine_models_desc: The local engine relies on the models below (official ModelScope sources, SHA256 integrity verification, tampered files refused). Downloads and configuration are admin-level operations (D-R2).
engine_disk_short: Not enough space; downloads may fail
engine_verify_tampered: Verification failed: files do not match official SHA256 and loading is refused; please re-download
engine_guide_title: Local engine is not ready yet
engine_guide_desc: Complete the following before enabling the local engine. Models are downloaded only from official ModelScope sources and verified with SHA256 on disk; verification failures refuse to load.
engine_guide_disk_body: Required models need ≈ {required} plus {buffer} download buffer; current free space is {free}.
engine_guide_disk_hint: Free up disk space and retry, or change the model storage location above to a larger disk.
engine_guide_missing_body: These required models are not ready: {names}. Click "Download all" to start the guided download (resumable).
engine_guide_tampered_body: These model files do not match official SHA256 and loading is refused: {names}. Please re-download; if it fails repeatedly, check whether disk tools or antivirus software modified the files.
engine_err_insufficient_disk: Insufficient disk space: free up space or change the model storage location, then retry
engine_err_unwritable_dir: Directory not writable: check path permissions and retry
engine_err_unknown_model: Unknown model, please refresh and retry
engine_err_models_tampered: Tampered models detected; startup refused: re-download them first
engine_err_models_missing: Required models missing; startup refused: complete the downloads first
engine_err_download_failed: Download failed: check your network and retry (partial data kept, resumable)
engine_mode_readonly: read-only echo · transcription source is chosen per-capability in ASR settings
